title: Privacy Policy
body:
## 1. Who we are and what this covers
Quanton Labs is a trade name of Remington Enterprises LLC, a South Carolina limited liability company. We build and operate Quanton OS, an AI-native business system that runs on a system of record each client business owns.

We handle personal information in two different roles, and this policy covers both:

| **Role**               | **Whose information**                                                                                                     | **Who decides how it is used** | **Part** |
|------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------|----------|
| **Website and sales**  | Visitors to quantonlabs.com, people who take the assessment, and prospects who contact us                                 | Quanton Labs                   | Part A   |
| **Client deployments** | Employees, crew leads, customers, and other people whose information a client business holds in its Quanton OS deployment | The client business            | Part B   |

# Part A: Our website and sales process
## 2. What we collect
1.  **Information you give us.** When you take the assessment, submit an inquiry, or book a call: your name, business name, role, email address, phone number, business website, and your answers to assessment questions.

2.  **Information collected automatically.** When you visit the site, analytics tools record pages visited, time on page, referring page, browser and device type, and approximate location derived from your IP address.

3.  **Cookies.** The site uses cookies for core functions and for analytics. You can block or delete cookies in your browser; some features may not work without them.

## 3. How we use it
1.  To produce your assessment report and send it to you.

2.  To respond to your inquiry and contact you about Quanton OS and our engagement process.

3.  To understand how the site is used and improve it.

4.  To meet legal obligations and protect our rights.

Assessment scores and reports are produced by fixed scoring rules. No AI model makes a decision about you, and nothing we do with your information produces a legal or similarly significant effect on you without a person's review.

## 4. Who we share it with
We do not sell, rent, or trade personal information, and we do not share it for targeted advertising. We share it only with providers that run our website and sales process for us:

| **Provider** | **Role**                                                                        |
|--------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Vercel**   | Website hosting, site analytics, and storage of assessment reports              |
| **Google**   | Site analytics (Google Analytics), email, and records of assessment submissions |
| **Calendly** | Call scheduling, when you book a call                                           |

We also disclose information where the law or valid legal process requires it, or in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of our business, under terms that protect it.

## 5. How long we keep it
Assessment and inquiry information is kept for 24 months after our last contact with you, then deleted, unless you become a client or the law requires us to keep it longer. Analytics data is kept under the retention settings of the analytics provider.

## 6. Your choices and rights
1.  You may ask to see, correct, or delete the personal information we hold about you, or ask us to stop contacting you. Email growth@quantonlabs.com. We respond within 30 days.

2.  Every marketing email we send includes a way to unsubscribe.

3.  We will not treat you differently for making a request.

# Part B: Client deployments
## 7. The client decides
Each Quanton OS deployment belongs to one client business. The records in it, including information about that business's employees, crew leads, customers, and vendors, are the client's data. The client decides what is collected and how it is used. Quanton Labs processes the information only to build, operate, and support the deployment for the client, under the client's Engagement Agreement.

If your information is held in a client's deployment, send requests to see, correct, or delete it to that business. Quanton Labs helps the client answer them.

## 8. What a deployment holds
Depending on how the client uses Quanton OS, a deployment may hold:

- business records: customers, orders, jobs, invoices, payments, contracts, and documents

- employee records the employer keeps: time records, pay stubs, time off, tasks, and training

- field photos and reports of the work; photos of people are rejected at capture

- messages between the business and its customers, vendors, and crew leads

- the audit trail of every action and approval in the deployment

## 9. How deployment data is protected
1.  **Isolation.** Every client runs on a dedicated deployment with its own database and file storage. No client's data is mixed with another's.

2.  **Purpose.** Data is used only to run the client's deployment. It is never sold, rented, or traded, and never used for advertising.

3.  **System performance learning.** Unless the client opts out, Quanton Labs studies de-identified, aggregated performance measures across deployments, such as acceptance rates, correction rates, and processing times, to improve Quanton OS. No records leave a deployment for this purpose, and nothing identifies the client or any person. Quanton Labs keeps this information de-identified and does not attempt to re-identify it.

4.  **Trading partners.** Where two businesses on Quanton OS connect, only the transaction messages between them are exchanged. No other record is reachable.

5.  **Security.** Data is encrypted in transit, access is limited by credentials and roles, and the audit trail cannot be altered. The client is notified within 72 hours of a confirmed security incident affecting its data.

6.  **Retention.** Data is kept as the client directs. When a client's engagement ends, its data is returned or deleted at its request, except where the law requires otherwise.

## 10. Providers that process deployment data
| **Provider**           | **Role**                                                                                          |
|------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Vercel**             | Application hosting                                                                               |
| **MongoDB**            | Database                                                                                          |
| **Cloudflare**         | File storage for documents and field photos                                                       |
| **OpenRouter**         | Routing of requests to AI model providers                                                         |
| **AI model providers** | Processing requests made by the deployment's agents, including reading documents for data capture |

These providers process data only to operate the deployment and answer requests made by its agents. Most run on accounts the client owns. The client's Engagement Agreement names each provider in use and requires 30 days' notice before one is added.

## 11. Text messages
Text messages from a client's deployment are sent by that business, to people who have agreed to receive them. Reply STOP to any text to stop texts from that business, and START to resume. Mobile numbers and text consent are never shared with third parties for their marketing.

## 12. Health information
Where a client is a healthcare provider covered by federal health privacy law, its deployment handles protected health information under a business associate agreement with Quanton Labs, and only with providers covered by the same type of agreement.

## 13. Younger users
Our website is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their information. A client may give an employee under 18 access to its worker app as their employer allows; the client is responsible for any consent the law requires. We do not sell, profile, or target advertising to anyone, at any age.

**GENERAL**

## 14. Changes to this policy
We update this policy when our practices or the law change. The current version is posted at quantonlabs.com/privacy with its effective date.

## 15. Contact
